description:
Daily FBIL INR reference rates (USD/GBP/EUR/JPY/AED/IDR against INR).

    `currency_pair` optionally filters to one pair (e.g. `"USD/INR"`, case-insensitive).
    `from_date`/`to_date` are optional ISO dates (default: trailing 30 days). Each row is
    `{rate_date, currency_pair, unit_base, rate, source}` — `rate` is always "INR per
    `unit_base` units of the foreign currency" (unit_base is 1 for USD/GBP/EUR/AED, 100 for JPY,
    10000 for IDR — FBIL's own published denomination, never silently rescaled). FBIL's public
    feed only serves a rolling ~2-day window with no bulk history archive found, so a fresh
    deploy accretes this table forward one scheduled refresh at a time — a wide window may
    legitimately return far fewer rows than the window implies.
name: get_fx_reference_rates
